            "Unsigned post-op materializers are disabled until the maintainer signs the registry."
        )

def _is_row_like(value: object) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping | BaseModel):

    if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
        return True
    if type(value).__name__ == "DatabaseRow":
        return True
    return callable(getattr(value, "keys", None))


def _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol: str) -> None:
    msg = (
        f"Forbidden executor-visible Python rowset publication from {symbol}: "
        "publish SQL-visible rows through a declared CTE contract instead."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def assert_executor_visible_publication_allowed(
    *,
    symbol: str,
    result: object,
    cte_relation_role: str | None,
    cte_output_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    scalar_control_kind: ScalarControlKind | None = None,
    scalar_value_column: LockedColumnName | None = None,
    approved_python_reentry: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Reject executor-visible Python rowset publication outside scalar control facts."""

    if approved_python_reentry:
        return
    columns = tuple(cte_output_columns or ())
    if isinstance(result, Sequence) and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        if not result:
            return
        if not (len(result) == 1 and isinstance(result[0], Mapping)):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        result = result[0]
    if _is_row_like(result) and not isinstance(result, Mapping):
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
    if scalar_control_kind is None or scalar_value_column is None:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} requires declared scalar control metadata."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    control_column = scalar_value_column.to_row_key()
    if control_column not in columns:
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} declares a scalar column outside its relation."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if len(columns) != 1 or columns[0] != control_column:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} must contain its declared scalar control fact."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if scalar_control_kind is ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT and cte_relation_role not in {None, "count_only"}:
        msg = f"Executor-visible count control fact from {symbol} has an incompatible relation role."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if isinstance(result, Mapping):
        if set(result) == {control_column} and not _is_row_like(result[control_column]):
            return
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)


def _update_signature_in_file(signature: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(__file__)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    new = f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"'
    updated, count = re.subn(
        r'^ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = (?:UNSIGNED|"[^"]*")$',
        new,
        text,
        count=1,
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if count != 1:
        msg = f"Expected one ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE assignment in {path}"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def _sign_allowlist() -> int:
    signature = sign_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_NAME, post_op_allowlist_entries())
    if signature is None:
        return 1
    print(f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"')
    if _update_signature_in_file(signature):
        print(f"Updated {Path(__file__)}")
    return 0


def cli_main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--sign-allowlist",
        action="store_true",
        help="Sign the runtime post-op allowlist with NERA_SIGNING_KEY",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.sign_allowlist:
        return _sign_allowlist()
    if _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid():
        print("Post-op runtime allowlist is signed.")
        return 0
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(cli_main())

        raise RuntimeError(msg)

    path = Path(__file__)

        r'^ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = (?:UNSIGNED|"[^"]*")$',

        text,
        count=1,
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if count != 1:
        msg = f"Expected one ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE assignment in {path}"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def _sign_allowlist() -> int:
    signature = sign_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_NAME, post_op_allowlist_entries())

        "--sign-allowlist",

def post_op_allowlist_entries() -> list[str]:
    """Return the sorted signed post-op runtime symbols."""

def _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid() -> bool:
    """Return whether the embedded runtime post-op allowlist signature is valid."""

    global _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache
    entries = tuple(post_op_allowlist_entries())
    cache_key = (entries, ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE)
    if _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache == cache_key:
        return True
    valid = verify_allowlist(
        ALLOWLIST_NAME,
        list(entries),
        ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE,
    )
    if valid:
        _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache = cache_key

def assert_post_op_symbol_signed(symbol: str) -> None:

    if not _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid():
        msg = (
            "Post-op runtime allowlist signature verification failed. "
            "Unsigned post-op materializers are disabled until the maintainer signs the registry."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if symbol in SIGNED_POST_OP_SYMBOLS:
        return
    msg = f"Compiled post-op symbol {symbol} is not in the signed runtime allowlist."
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _is_row_like(value: object) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping | BaseModel):
        return True
    if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
        return True
    if type(value).__name__ == "DatabaseRow":
        return True
    return callable(getattr(value, "keys", None))


def _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol: str) -> None:
    msg = (
        f"Forbidden executor-visible Python rowset publication from {symbol}: "
        "publish SQL-visible rows through a declared CTE contract instead."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def assert_executor_visible_publication_allowed(
    *,
    symbol: str,
    result: object,
    cte_relation_role: str | None,
    cte_output_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    scalar_control_kind: ScalarControlKind | None = None,
    scalar_value_column: LockedColumnName | None = None,
    approved_python_reentry: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Reject executor-visible Python rowset publication outside scalar control facts."""

    if approved_python_reentry:
        return
    columns = tuple(cte_output_columns or ())
    if isinstance(result, Sequence) and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        if not result:
            return
        if not (len(result) == 1 and isinstance(result[0], Mapping)):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        result = result[0]
    if _is_row_like(result) and not isinstance(result, Mapping):
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
    if scalar_control_kind is None or scalar_value_column is None:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} requires declared scalar control metadata."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    control_column = scalar_value_column.to_row_key()
    if control_column not in columns:
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} declares a scalar column outside its relation."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if len(columns) != 1 or columns[0] != control_column:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} must contain its declared scalar control fact."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if scalar_control_kind is ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT and cte_relation_role not in {None, "count_only"}:
        msg = f"Executor-visible count control fact from {symbol} has an incompatible relation role."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if isinstance(result, Mapping):
        if set(result) == {control_column} and not _is_row_like(result[control_column]):
            return
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)


def _update_signature_in_file(signature: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(__file__)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    new = f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"'
    updated, count = re.subn(
        r'^ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = (?:UNSIGNED|"[^"]*")$',
        new,
        text,
        count=1,
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if count != 1:
        msg = f"Expected one ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE assignment in {path}"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def _sign_allowlist() -> int:
    signature = sign_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_NAME, post_op_allowlist_entries())
    if signature is None:
        return 1
    print(f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"')
    if _update_signature_in_file(signature):
        print(f"Updated {Path(__file__)}")
    return 0


def cli_main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:

        "--sign-allowlist",
        action="store_true",
        help="Sign the runtime post-op allowlist with NERA_SIGNING_KEY",
    )

    if args.sign_allowlist:
        return _sign_allowlist()
    if _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid():
        print("Post-op runtime allowlist is signed.")
        return 0
    return 1

def post_op_allowlist_entries() -> list[str]:
    """Return the sorted signed post-op runtime symbols."""

    return sorted(SIGNED_POST_OP_SYMBOLS)


def _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid() -> bool:
    """Return whether the embedded runtime post-op allowlist signature is valid."""

    global _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache
    entries = tuple(post_op_allowlist_entries())
    cache_key = (entries, ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE)
    if _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache == cache_key:
        return True
    valid = verify_allowlist(
        ALLOWLIST_NAME,
        list(entries),
        ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE,
    )
    if valid:
        _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache = cache_key
    return valid


def _clear_post_op_allowlist_signature_cache_for_tests() -> None:
    """Clear the runtime post-op signature cache for focused tests."""

    global _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache
    _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid_cache = None


def assert_post_op_symbol_signed(symbol: str) -> None:
    """Reject a compiled post-op symbol unless it is covered by a valid signature."""

    if not _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid():
        msg = (
            "Post-op runtime allowlist signature verification failed. "
            "Unsigned post-op materializers are disabled until the maintainer signs the registry."
        )
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if symbol in SIGNED_POST_OP_SYMBOLS:
        return
    msg = f"Compiled post-op symbol {symbol} is not in the signed runtime allowlist."
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def _is_row_like(value: object) -> bool:
    if isinstance(value, Mapping | BaseModel):
        return True
    if is_dataclass(value) and not isinstance(value, type):
        return True
    if type(value).__name__ == "DatabaseRow":
        return True
    return callable(getattr(value, "keys", None))


def _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol: str) -> None:
    msg = (
        f"Forbidden executor-visible Python rowset publication from {symbol}: "
        "publish SQL-visible rows through a declared CTE contract instead."
    )
    raise RuntimeError(msg)


def assert_executor_visible_publication_allowed(
    *,
    symbol: str,
    result: object,
    cte_relation_role: str | None,
    cte_output_columns: Sequence[str] | None,
    scalar_control_kind: ScalarControlKind | None = None,
    scalar_value_column: LockedColumnName | None = None,
    approved_python_reentry: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Reject executor-visible Python rowset publication outside scalar control facts."""

    if approved_python_reentry:
        return
    columns = tuple(cte_output_columns or ())
    if isinstance(result, Sequence) and not isinstance(result, (str, bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        if not result:
            return
        if not (len(result) == 1 and isinstance(result[0], Mapping)):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        result = result[0]
    if _is_row_like(result) and not isinstance(result, Mapping):
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
    if scalar_control_kind is None or scalar_value_column is None:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} requires declared scalar control metadata."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    control_column = scalar_value_column.to_row_key()
    if control_column not in columns:
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} declares a scalar column outside its relation."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if len(columns) != 1 or columns[0] != control_column:
        if isinstance(result, Mapping):
            _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)
        msg = f"Executor-visible runtime publication from {symbol} must contain its declared scalar control fact."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if scalar_control_kind is ScalarControlKind.AFFECTED_COUNT and cte_relation_role not in {None, "count_only"}:
        msg = f"Executor-visible count control fact from {symbol} has an incompatible relation role."
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    if isinstance(result, Mapping):
        if set(result) == {control_column} and not _is_row_like(result[control_column]):
            return
        _raise_forbidden_executor_publication(symbol)


def _update_signature_in_file(signature: str) -> bool:
    path = Path(__file__)
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    new = f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"'
    updated, count = re.subn(
        r'^ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = (?:UNSIGNED|"[^"]*")$',
        new,
        text,
        count=1,
        flags=re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if count != 1:
        msg = f"Expected one ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE assignment in {path}"
        raise RuntimeError(msg)
    path.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8")
    return True


def _sign_allowlist() -> int:
    signature = sign_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_NAME, post_op_allowlist_entries())
    if signature is None:
        return 1
    print(f'ALLOWLIST_SIGNATURE: str = "{signature}"')
    if _update_signature_in_file(signature):
        print(f"Updated {Path(__file__)}")
    return 0


def cli_main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--sign-allowlist",
        action="store_true",
        help="Sign the runtime post-op allowlist with NERA_SIGNING_KEY",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.sign_allowlist:
        return _sign_allowlist()
    if _post_op_allowlist_signature_valid():
        print("Post-op runtime allowlist is signed.")
        return 0
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(cli_main())
